scenario: 2023 IRS published single sample-table row at $25,300 taxable income, exercised through synthetic wage inputs
source: IRS 2023 Instructions for Form 1040 Tax and Earned Income Credit Tables, PDF/printed page 3, Sample Table, Single column, taxable income $25,300–$25,350 row; https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-prior/i1040tt--2023.pdf. Standard-deduction input construction: IRS 2023 Form 1040, page 1 Standard Deduction for sidebar; https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-prior/f1040--2023.pdf. Retained PDF digests and rendered evidence: docs/historical-federal/benchmark-sources.json.
synthetic_inputs: Explicitly synthetic consumer inputs, not an IRS-published complete household or W-2. Wages $39,150 = published taxable income $25,300 + sourced 2023 single basic standard deduction $13,850. Synthetic filers are under 65, nonblind, not dependents, with no other income, adjustments or itemized deductions. W-2 withholding is synthetic zero required by its schema. Only the published taxable-income and tax-table lines are scored; no total-tax, payments, refund or amount-owed oracle is asserted.
